newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan govt cautious about big extra budget--MOF.
newsitem.headline: Japan govt cautious about big extra budget--MOF.

text.p: The Japanese government is very cautious about adopting a large-scale supplementary budget to support the economy during the current fiscal year, Finance Minister Wataru Kubo said on Wednesday.
In a speech to business executives, Kubo said the economy continued to recover gradually with private-sector demand showing improvement.
"There are calls for a large-scale supplementary budget as a measure to stimulate the economy. But the government is taking a very cautious stance against such calls," Kubo said.
